description: Selects the access logs dataset and which of its rows to export. An empty list does not restrict; the values of one list are alternatives, and populated lists combine (AND). An empty selector exports every row. createTime is when this dataset was enabled, where its live export starts. Filter changes preserve createTime; disabling and re-enabling the dataset gives it a new createTime. Timestamps are server owned.
